title: Pass 5 evidence-desert data-demand backlog
governing_rule: Do not write around absences. Specify exact series, geography, and years; route through the public-statistics / RCIP pipeline. Prefer observation arrays behind existing evidence systems over new decorative panels.

demands.series: Real average hourly earnings over-the-year percent change (CES, CPI-U deflated) — multi-year monthly or annual path matching CC-IND-L01
geography: AR if definition-locked CES analogue exists
demands.why: Turn L01 snapshot into history; test whether recent +1.1% is typical.

demands.series: Nonfarm business labor productivity annual percent change path matching CC-IND-L02
demands.why: Test productivity–wage relationship over decades beside current 2.3% dial.

demands.series: JOLTS voluntary quits rate annual averages from series start (~2000)
demands.why: Mobility dial history behind L04.

demands.series: SCF triennial real median and mean family net worth table
demands.why: Replace two-survey episode endpoints with full ownership history.

demands.series: DFA wealth shares by percentile (bottom 50, middle 40, next 9, top 1) quarterly
demands.why: Test whether 2026-Q1 concentration levels are durable.

demands.series: Federal receipts % GDP, outlays % GDP, debt held by the public % GDP — Historical Budget Data
demands.years_prefer: post-WWII or full CBO historical span
demands.why: Credibility of fiscal context for no-PIT/no-property-tax redesign requires history, not one FY.

demands.series: Average federal tax rates by income group over time
demands.why: Tax composition / distributional history behind prosperity-tax claims.

demands.series: Federal revenue composition shares (individual, corporate, payroll, excise, other) historical
demands.why: Composition matters more than a single receipts/GDP cell for redesign debates.

demands.series: Community-bank domestic deposit share; community-bank + credit-union loan share (QBP)
demands.why: Local capital access as history, not one quarter.

demands.series: ESTABS_ENTRY, ESTABS_ENTRY_RATE, ESTABS_EXIT_RATE annual paths
demands.why: Rural/market dynamics need entry/exit histories, not one-year rates.

demands.series: Decennial Census urban/rural share; ERS nonmetro population and county-decline series (keep definitions separate)
demands.why: Rural prosperity claims need definition-labeled geographic change.

demands.series: Primary-care HPSA population share dated snapshots (do not substitute mental-health HPSA)
demands.why: Turn E05 22% into a path.

demands.series: Arkansas primary-care HPSA population share and county designations
demands.why: National 22% is not an Arkansas access map.

demands.series: Fixed-NAICS multi-year CR4/CR8 sample table (selected industries)
demands.why: Enforcement counts are not competitiveness; need structural concentration cells.

demands.agency: BEA / academic official-adjacent products (definition lock first)
demands.series: Comparable markup or price-cost margin series with explicit methodology
demands.why: Structural competitiveness measure beyond entry/enforcement.

demands.series: Arkansas establishment entry/exit counts and rates
demands.why: National dynamics ≠ Arkansas market change.

demands.dataset: Monthly Energy Review / Annual Energy Review
demands.series: Primary energy production, consumption, and net exports (quads), annual
demands.why: Energy desert #1 — abundance/net-export claims need the full path, not one record year.

demands.series: Electricity net generation (TWh) annual; generation capacity where comparable
demands.why: Generation dial history behind 2025 record endpoint.

demands.series: Crude oil production (mb/d) annual finalized series
demands.why: Production history; STEO annuals may revise.

demands.series: LNG exports (Bcf/d or Bcf annual); petroleum net trade status; crude vs products imports/exports
demands.years_prefer: 2016–present LNG; petroleum status from 2000s or official start
demands.why: Export potential and sovereignty-not-autarky require series, not slogans.

demands.series: Electricity prices and/or household energy burden — definition lock required before ingest
demands.why: Affordability claims currently outrun attached evidence.

demands.series: Reliability metrics where measurable and definition-locked (e.g., SAIDI/SAIFI or official outage series)
demands.why: Reliability is claimed in doctrine; not yet empirically attached.

demands.series: IOU / municipal / cooperative customer shares or equivalent ownership structure map
demands.why: Public/private ownership structure for community energy claims.

demands.series: Arkansas production by source, consumption, prices, generation capacity
demands.why: National endpoints are not Arkansas energy accounts.

explicit_non_demands: Do not invent National Energy Prosperity Fund / public-return outcome metrics before definition lock.
Do not invent a national CR4 percent.
Do not treat Google Civic as available until IP restriction clears.
Do not move CC-CLAIM-003 off Not Enough Evidence without new causal evidence.
